transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Nvidia launches modular artificial intelligence factory design, shortening deployment from 6 months to 14 days, reported by 36氪.
Meta artificial intelligence creates quick video clips while MagicLight artificial intelligence builds long-form stories with scripts and consistent characters, reported by Techloy.
Nvidia's DSX POD cuts artificial intelligence factory deployment to 14 days, launching in early 2027, confirmed by nvidianews dot nvidia dot com.
Nvidia expands agent toolkit for enterprises to build secure, data-informed artificial intelligence agents, confirmed by blogs dot nvidia dot com.
The U.S. administration orders removal of DeepSeek artificial intelligence from federal systems over security risks, confirmed by koreatimes dot com.
